name: M101 / Pinwheel Galaxy
mask_policy: Finite IMAGE and positive NHITS; OVERFLOW, OUTLIER and unknown bits excluded; SOURCE alone retained.
release: Not identified in the distributed cube; do not assume QR2/QR3 equivalence.
time_composition: Multiple input observations; their individual IDs and acquisition dates are not supplied by this tutorial cube. Not a temporal frame.
limitations: No variance extension is supplied; NHITS is coverage, not uncertainty.
Wavelength changes reveal different infrared emission; they do not show change over time.
Plane-dependent gaps and residual stripes/artifacts remain visible.
processing: Original spatial samples, units and flags retained. No interpolation, background subtraction, smoothing or inpainting. Per-plane display limits cannot measure spectral or temporal variability.
credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/IPAC; official IRSA SPHEREx Mosaic Tool tutorial product.
